subject: 114 Mystic Avenue Marijuana Dispensary Special Permit
overview: The Board approved a fence variance and a residential finding, while dismissing one application for untimeliness. Petitions for an industrial fence, a residential garage studio, and a new retail marijuana dispensary were continued for further documentation and departmental review.

items.title: 436 Riverside Avenue Variance
items.summary: Continued the petition for a 10-foot fence variance in an industrial district to the next meeting at the applicant's request.

items.title: 55 Burgett Avenue Fence Variance
items.summary: Approved a variance for an eight-foot fence based on unique topography and elevation differences, despite a neighbor's concerns regarding shadows and loss of sunlight.

items.title: 93 Governors Avenue Garage Variance
items.summary: Continued the petition for a two-story garage and music studio addition to allow the applicant to address concerns regarding soundproofing, lot coverage, and home occupation criteria.

items.title: 80 Canal Street Jurisdictional Dismissal
items.summary: Deemed the application for residential alterations invalid because the appeal was filed after the statutory 30-day timeline following the building commissioner's refusal.

items.title: 18 Edward Street Dormer Finding
items.summary: Approved a finding to add dormers to a non-conforming three-family dwelling, concluding the expansion was not substantially more detrimental to the neighborhood.

items.title: 114 Mystic Avenue Marijuana Dispensary Special Permit
items.summary: Continued the special permit application for New England Organics LLC to operate a retail marijuana dispensary at the VFW hall to allow for required meetings with city departments and the submission of a formal site plan.

items.title: Administrative Items and Minutes
items.summary: Approved the January 26, 2023 meeting minutes and briefly discussed board member term renewals and staggering requirements.
